name: Collect security patrol reports and escalate urgent incidents with gpt-6-luna, Google Sheets, and Gmail

parameters.content:
## Collect security patrol reports and escalate urgent incidents

### How it works

A guard submits a patrol log or incident report on a hosted form from any phone. The report is normalized, checked for missing details, and graded by an AI agent that classifies severity and writes a summary the supervisor can read in ten seconds.

Every report is appended to the Security Log in Google Sheets. Urgent reports email the ops supervisor immediately, and the site client gets an urgent incident notice in the same run.

A daily run at 06:00 emails a digest of the last 24 hours. On the 1st of the month an AI review covers the last 30 days and lands in the ops manager inbox.

### Setup steps

- Create a spreadsheet with a tab named Security Log, using the column list in the workflow description.
- Connect Google Sheets, Gmail and an [OI] chat model credential.
- Set the supervisor and client emails in the Normalize Report node.
- Share the hosted form URL with the guards and activate the workflow.

### Customization

- Add SMS or Telegram alerts alongside the urgent emails.
- Adjust the severity rules in the classification system message.
- Change the daily and monthly schedule times in the schedule triggers.

## 1. Report intake and escalation

Guards fill the form, the report is validated, classified by AI and logged. Urgent reports email the supervisor and the client right away.

## 2. Daily activity report

Every day at 06:00 the last 24 hours of reports are summarized and emailed to the ops manager.

## 3. Monthly site review

On the first of the month an AI review of totals, incidents, urgent items and busiest sites is emailed to the ops manager.

options.systemMessage: You are the operations assistant at a private security company. Officers submit patrol logs and incident reports through a mobile form. Read ONLY the supplied report details. Decide severity: urgent (immediate threat to people or property, police/fire/medical likely needed), normal (incident or notable event that needs attention but is not an emergency), or informational (routine observation, no action needed). Write a one paragraph summary a supervisor can read in 10 seconds. For urgent reports give one suggested action (police, fire, medical, or supervisor). Keep the summary under 60 words, plain text, no markdown, no em dashes. Return ONLY valid JSON with exactly these keys: severity (one of urgent, normal, informational), summary (string), suggested_action (string).

options.systemMessage: You are the operations assistant at a private security company. Write the monthly security review email for the ops manager. Use ONLY the supplied data. Write 3 to 5 plain sentences: the total number of reports, how many were incidents and how many urgent, which sites had the most activity, and one practical suggestion (extra patrols, camera check, briefing). If there were urgent incidents, name the site in one short line. No markdown, no bullets, no em dashes, under 140 words. Return ONLY valid JSON with exactly these keys: subject (max 10 words) and body (the full email).
